drawings.description: schéma de la marge gauche ; au-dessous, un second schéma du même genre ($X_0$, $X$, $E$, $k_0$, $A_0$, $k$, $\mathbb{Q}$) est couvert de hachures et de traits, illisible
drawings.kind: two diagrams of fields and schemes (margin), the second hatched over
drawings.notes: Redrawn on a tight crop. Upper figure: X_0 - X over k_0 - A_0 - k with the two vertical strokes, the columns aligned (X_0 over A_0, X over k); the stroke k_0 - k is one stroke in the original with A_0 written on it, drawn as two pieces either side of the label. Lower figure (covered with hatching and loops): E - k_0 - A_0 on a heavy line, X_0 above with a vertical stroke through the line, a heavy stroke from X_0 up to the right, at the top right a dash and X with an arrow up from k (the arrowhead under X is a reading), below a heavy stroke from E down to A_0 and a heavy stroke from A_0 up to the right, a heavy stroke at the bottom; the hatched area over the right half is a hatched polygon, the long thin stroke from E to X and two of the loops at the bottom are drawn in pencil. Left out: a second X_0 scribbled over at the top of the hatched area, the remaining crossing strokes and loops. The Q of the transcription is not located with certainty (perhaps the loop at the bottom left, drawn as a loop without a label). Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.
